chunks: I said to Abu Al-Hassan (peace be upon him): 'Indeed among us there is a group of people who have love [for the Ahlul Bayt], but they do not have that firm resolve — they profess this declaration [of al-Wilayah].'
So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Those are not among those whom Allah has admonished. Rather Allah said:
"Therefore take a lesson, O you who have vision." [Quran 59:2]

key_terms.أُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ: people of vision or insight; in Quranic usage, those who can perceive moral lessons from events
key_terms.الْعَزِيمَةُ: firm resolve or determination; in this context refers to the complete conviction and commitment to al-Wilayah as an obligation
key_terms.الْقَوْلِ: the word/declaration; refers specifically to the declaration of al-Wilayah (loyalty to the Imams)
key_terms.عَاتَبَ: to reproach or admonish; indicates Divine blame or holding accountable
key_terms.مَحَبَّةٌ: love/affection; here refers to heartfelt love for the Ahlul Bayt without full doctrinal commitment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Al-Ridha say about people who love the Ahlul Bayt but lack firm resolve in accepting al-Wilayah?
ai.summary: Al-Hassan ibn Al-Jahm asks Imam Al-Ridha (AS) about people who love the Ahlul Bayt but lack the firm resolve (al-azimah) to fully commit to al-Wilayah. The Imam clarifies that such people are not subject to Allah's reproach, citing Quran 59:2 to indicate that Divine admonition is directed at those with insight who fail to draw lessons — implying that those without firm conviction are in a different category. This hadith is found in the chapter on the obligations of al-Wilayah, distinguishing between sincere love with incomplete commitment and culpable failure to reflect.
word_analysis: so take a lesson / take heed

en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Hassan Bin Al Jahm who said, 
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘In our presence there is a group of people, for them is love, and there isn’t that magnificence for them that they should be saying with this word (Al-Wilayah)’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are from the ones whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Admonished. But rather, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Said
[59:2] therefore take a lesson, O you who have vision’.
